newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets mostly quiet.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets mostly quiet.

text.p: Generally quiet trading conditions were reported on Tuesday by most European cotton merchants. Price incentive continued to be lacking particularly in the face of the strong dollar, traders said.
The limited transactions have again involved Central Asian descriptions for nearby shipment, for which some sellers' asking rates are still described as attractive.
Forward buying interest has remained generally low though offers of Central Asian and West African 1997/98 crop styles have apparently been under consideration by some prospective buyers in Italy.
